title: WTShiftBench: a problem-solving benchmark protocol for endpoint-aligned auditing of transcriptomic perturbation model outputs
description: WTShiftBench v1.2.2 provides English public documentation and updated distribution links for the unchanged v1.2.1 scientific assets: sampling-aware endpoints, scoring with explicit target and gene axes, five-seed CellOT evaluation, and reported training- and feature-seed checks. Scoring implementations, numerical results, matrices and training assets are unchanged. The code snapshot is not the complete data archive. The verified execution path remains reproducibility/v1.2.1/. See the English guide for downloads and the scope of actual verification.
